tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Day 19 21:27 feedback showed nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It moves between living, kitchen, and bedroom. Do not rely on time-of-day; check the most recent known location, prioritizing nightstand_b1 for late evening.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Day 19 16:01 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of desk_b1. It stays in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Day 19 20:11 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It moves between living, kitchen table, and dish rack. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late evening locations.

mug_felix: Moves between living and kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning, coffee_table_l1 for other times.

book_felix: Inconsistent. I repeatedly guessed nightstand_b1 on Day 16 but it was at coffee_table_l1. The object stays in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Day 19 07:10 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guess of sink_ba_ba1. It moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.

glass_felix: Inconsistent. Day 12 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, but Day 13 22:10 feedback showed nightstand_b1. It moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night locations.
